author: FluffLove
body: im not a big fan of towers (i got wrecked as a Realmy when they were brand new), but summoner is a very safe class. Taken with benefactor for the red genie guy (i forget name) as one of first 2 summons so hes present at battle start. Red genie is always an AoE elemental attack so good chance of clearing the trash on turn 1. First celestial class, i got the one with Ancient dragon, but i dont use the class, just the summon. Many people suggest the summoner who can equip warrior gear for greater ward and survival.

author: Far-Negotiation-9691
body:
The best class overall is beoH. Juste look the top rank.

But you need a crit build with yelmogus staff /swansong, 100% crit with lyncus hair, heretic wardrobe.
Or kaladanda (or qatvanga ??) And a lot of magic thing

Else beoA is a good and safe option with fey cactus but very slow. Killing titan is very easy with a 80% res dragon/dark/holy/arcane and a good pet like fjalar, or arisen spiritgarm.

In pure stat beoH have more stat than GsH and Dara/Dursa/Gursa so for thing like tower and monument BeoH is the best.

For Horde mode, GsH and Dara are better.

author: Pixeldensity
body: BeoA is good with fey cactus at lower levels then switch to spiritgarm for higher floors. Spiritgarm is great for the end bosses as well, cactus not so much.

author: dfoley323
body:
For low AL SMN and BEO (or BEOA) are both good.  

Both classes let you focus on ward/buffing while your pets do the damage.  For BEO (A) i go with arisen spirit garm or mamom acolyte.  The goal is to delete 1 enemy a turn so you dont get over whelmed.

For summoner, the pet choices vary a lot more but the idea is the same. Turtle up, open with ward and defensive buffs, then summon extra pets to help deal dmg.

author: Lwessh
body: BeoA com cacto sobrenatural funciona bem ou pode usar GSA com benefactor que funciona de forma segura para escalar torres( ainda mais se tiver AD ou mamute de ossos)
